Portland hosts San Antonio in the Trail Blazers' ninth game of the season, with the home side at 6-2 overall, 5-1 on the road and 1-1 at home. Portland sits 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the West after a loss in its most recent game. The Spurs arrive at 7-2 on a seven-game winning streak, 3-0 on the road and 4-2 at home, second in the Southwest and fourth in the West.

The teams have not met yet this season, but Portland lost 1-2 to San Antonio in the 2025-26 regular season and 1-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 114-95 loss in San Antonio on April 28. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
